name: Warrior
description: A master of arms and armor. Warriors excel at melee combat and can take tremendous punishment.

skills.name: Power Strike
skills.description: A heavy blow that deals 150% weapon damage.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.description: Bash with your shield, dealing damage and stunning for 1 turn.

skills.name: War Cry
skills.description: Let loose a fearsome cry, boosting attack by 25% for 3 turns.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.description: Swing in a wide arc, hitting all enemies for 120% damage.

skills.name: Iron Will
skills.description: Harden your resolve, boosting defense by 50% for 2 turns.
